decision: proceed with fixed unchanged-source diagnostic matrix
independent_review: Strace6.19 has libunwind stacks and demangling; DHAT3.26 is available.
Mapping syscalls do not identify physical page faults or the faulting instruction.
Require resolved local owner/caller stacks; unavailable or truncated stacks cannot establish owner absence.
Existing procfs snapshot calls can bracket iterations without source changes.
DHAT replacement allocator changes mapping behavior; only stack-attributed cumulative allocation observations are used.
coordinator_resolution: Trace openat plus six memory syscalls. Use the before status-open to after io-open bracket, which conservatively contains the phase plus before-probe tail.
Only events with both write_plain and ordinary_save::run_case are attributed to serialization; probe activity remains separate.
Require ordered io/stat/status triplets,64 control snapshots and600 iteration snapshots; skip100warmup pairs and align200measured pairs with raw acquisition-order deltas.
Retain all8children even if no desired fault regime appears; no replacement or adaptive profiling lane.
The standalone harness has its own workspace; root workspace LTO settings are not assumed to apply. Actual stack resolution remains mandatory.
prior_decisions: 0715 section collection and0618 preservation compressor pooling remain rejected.
